question:
Spot the error.

Though the weather conditions were extremely unfavourable and most of the mountain roads were blocked by landslides, but (A) / the rescue team managed to reach the isolated village (B) / before the supplies of food and medicines ran out. (C)

options.text: Though the weather conditions were extremely unfavourable and most of the mountain roads were blocked by landslides, but
the rescue team managed to reach the isolated village
before the supplies of food and medicines ran out.

explanation: 'Though/Although' वाले clause के साथ main clause में 'but' नहीं लगता (contrast दो बार हो जाता है): 'Though ..., the rescue team managed' ('but' हटाइए)।

question:
Spot the error.

Though the firm had suffered heavy losses in the last two financial years, (A) / yet it refused to lay off any of its employees (B) / or to reduce their salaries. (C)

options.text: Though the firm had suffered heavy losses in the last two financial years,
yet it refused to lay off any of its employees

explanation: 'Though ... yet' का जोड़ा स्वीकार्य है ('yet' का प्रयोग सही है), जबकि 'though ... but' गलत होता है। इसलिए कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

Everyone in the village admired the old man's courage, (A) / because he continued to work in the fields (B) / in spite of he was nearly eighty years old. (C)

options.text: Everyone in the village admired the old man's courage,
because he continued to work in the fields
in spite of he was nearly eighty years old.

explanation: 'In spite of' preposition है, इसके बाद clause नहीं आता। Clause के लिए 'although' या 'in spite of the fact that' आता है: 'although he was nearly eighty years old'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

[Despite of the fact that] the company had incurred heavy losses for three consecutive years, its chairman refused to reduce the salaries of the senior executives.
explanation: 'Despite' स्वयं preposition है, इसके साथ 'of' नहीं लगता: 'Despite the fact that' (या 'In spite of the fact that')।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Although the committee had thoroughly examined every aspect of the proposal, [it was unable to reach] a unanimous decision.

options.text: but it was unable to reach
yet it was not able reaching

explanation: 'Although' के साथ main clause में 'but' नहीं आता, इसलिए 'it was unable to reach' सही है। कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

Since the roads leading to the school were completely flooded after the cyclone, therefore (A) / the district administration declared a holiday (B) / for all educational institutions for three days. (C)

options.text: Since the roads leading to the school were completely flooded after the cyclone, therefore
the district administration declared a holiday
for all educational institutions for three days.

explanation: 'Since/Because/As' (कारण) के साथ 'therefore/so' का दोहराव नहीं होता: 'Since the roads ... were flooded, the district administration declared a holiday'।

question:
Spot the error.

The entire evening was ruined at the railway station, (A) / because the express train was delayed by nearly three hours, so (B) / the passengers missed their connecting flight to Delhi. (C)

options.text: The entire evening was ruined at the railway station,
because the express train was delayed by nearly three hours, so
the passengers missed their connecting flight to Delhi.

explanation: 'Because' के साथ 'so' नहीं लगता: 'because the train was delayed ..., the passengers missed'।

question:
Spot the error.

He worked day and night for several months, but however (A) / he could not secure a place in the merit list (B) / of the highly competitive examination. (C)

options.text: He worked day and night for several months, but however
he could not secure a place in the merit list

explanation: 'But' और 'however' दोनों contrast बताते हैं, इसलिए 'but however' का दोहराव गलत है: दोनों में से एक ही लगाइए।

question:
Spot the error.

The students had revised the entire syllabus thoroughly before the test, (A) / and failed to answer even the simplest questions (B) / because of nervousness in the examination hall. (C)

options.text: The students had revised the entire syllabus thoroughly before the test,
and failed to answer even the simplest questions
because of nervousness in the examination hall.

explanation: विरोध (contrast) दिखाने के लिए 'but' आता है, 'and' नहीं: 'had revised ... but failed to answer'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

[Provided if] the government approves the revised plan, the construction of the flyover will begin next month.
explanation: 'Provided' के बाद 'that' आता है (या सीधे 'If'): 'Provided that the government approves'।

question:
Spot the error.

Unless the district authorities do not take immediate steps to repair the damaged embankment, (A) / the entire locality will be flooded (B) / when the heavy monsoon rains arrive next month. (C)

options.text: Unless the district authorities do not take immediate steps to repair the damaged embankment,
the entire locality will be flooded
when the heavy monsoon rains arrive next month.

explanation: 'Unless' का अर्थ 'if not' है, इसलिए उसके साथ दोबारा 'not' नहीं लगता: 'Unless the authorities take immediate steps'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

[Even though] the government increases the subsidy on fertilisers next year, small farmers will still face difficulties.
explanation: अनिश्चित/काल्पनिक स्थिति के लिए 'even if' आता है; 'even though' निश्चित तथ्य के लिए होता है। भविष्य की संभावना के लिए 'Even if'।

question:
Spot the error.

You should carry an umbrella with you today (A) / in case if it rains in the afternoon (B) / as the weather forecast has predicted heavy showers. (C)

options.text: You should carry an umbrella with you today
in case if it rains in the afternoon
as the weather forecast has predicted heavy showers.

explanation: 'In case' खुद 'if' का अर्थ रखता है, इसलिए 'in case if' का दोहराव गलत है: 'in case it rains'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

You must submit the application form before the last date [else] it will not be considered by the selection committee.
explanation: 'Else' अकेले conjunction नहीं है; 'otherwise' या 'or else' आता है।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The bank will sanction the loan [as long as] you submit all the required documents before the end of this month.
explanation: 'As long as' (जब तक/इस शर्त पर) सही शर्त-बोधक conjunction है, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The old man drove very slowly on the slippery hill road lest he [will meet] with an accident.
explanation: 'Lest' के बाद 'should' आता है: 'lest he should meet with an accident'।

question:
Spot the error.

The students were repeatedly warned to revise the entire syllabus carefully (A) / lest they may fail (B) / in the examination for want of proper preparation. (C)

options.text: The students were repeatedly warned to revise the entire syllabus carefully
in the examination for want of proper preparation.

explanation: 'Lest' के बाद 'should' (या subjunctive) आता है, 'may' नहीं: 'lest they should fail'।

question:
Spot the error.

He left for the railway station much earlier than usual (A) / and took the shortest possible route (B) / so as that he could catch the morning train to Lucknow. (C)

options.text: He left for the railway station much earlier than usual
and took the shortest possible route
so as that he could catch the morning train to Lucknow.

explanation: उद्देश्य के लिए 'so that' या 'so as to' आता है; 'so as that' गलत है: 'so that he could catch'।

question:
Spot the error.

The inaugural match of the tournament had to be cancelled because of the ground staff went on a sudden strike (A) / and the organisers announced (B) / that fresh dates would be notified soon. (C)

options.text: The inaugural match of the tournament had to be cancelled because of the ground staff went on a sudden strike
that fresh dates would be notified soon.

explanation: 'Because of' (preposition) के बाद noun आता है, clause नहीं; clause के लिए 'because' आता है: 'because the ground staff went on a strike'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The final match of the tournament was postponed [due to that] the ground was waterlogged after the unexpected downpour.
explanation: Clause से पहले 'because' आता है; 'due to / because of' के बाद noun आता है।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The speech delivered by the chief guest was [so lengthy as] the audience grew restless and many people started leaving the hall.
explanation: परिणाम बताने के लिए 'so ... that' आता है, 'so ... as' नहीं: 'so lengthy that the audience grew restless'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

He was [so a kind man] that everyone in the neighbourhood respected him.
explanation: 'So' के बाद 'a + noun' नहीं आता। 'such a kind man' या 'so kind a man' आता है।

question:
Spot the error.

The flood that devastated the coastal districts last year (A) / was such a terrible disaster (B) / as thousands of families lost their homes and livelihood. (C)

options.text: The flood that devastated the coastal districts last year
as thousands of families lost their homes and livelihood.

explanation: परिणाम के लिए 'such ... that' आता है: 'such a terrible disaster that thousands of families lost'। ('Such ... as' तुलना/उदाहरण के लिए आता है।)

question:
Spot the error.

The mathematics problem set by the examiner was so complicated (A) / that nobody in the class could not solve it (B) / within the stipulated time of two hours. (C)

options.text: The mathematics problem set by the examiner was so complicated
that nobody in the class could not solve it
within the stipulated time of two hours.

explanation: 'So ... that nobody could not' में double negative है: 'that nobody in the class could solve it'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The newly appointed director of the corporation is [not so efficient than] his predecessor was, and the employees are not satisfied with his decisions.
explanation: 'Not so ... as' (या 'not as ... as') की तुलना में 'than' नहीं आता: 'not so efficient as his predecessor'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The new tax regime is [not so complicated as] the earlier one was, and taxpayers have welcomed it.
explanation: 'Not so complicated as' सही तुलना है, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The new batsman is [as tall or taller than] the captain of the team and is expected to play a major role in the tournament.

options.text: as tall as or taller than

explanation: 'As ... as' का पहला जोड़ा पूरा होना चाहिए: 'as tall as or taller than'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

This year's wheat production is [as good if not better than] last year's, despite the delayed monsoon.

options.text: as good than, if not better as
as good as, if not better than
so good, if not better than

explanation: तुलना में दोनों हिस्से पूरे होने चाहिए: 'as good as, if not better than'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The new smartphone model is far costlier [as] the previous one, but its battery life is not any better.
explanation: Comparative degree (costlier) के बाद 'than' आता है।

question:
Spot the error.

No sooner had the chief guest taken his seat on the dais when (A) / the cultural programme began with a prayer song (B) / sung by the students of the school choir. (C)

options.text: No sooner had the chief guest taken his seat on the dais when
the cultural programme began with a prayer song
sung by the students of the school choir.

explanation: 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' आता है, 'when' नहीं: 'No sooner had ... than the programme began'।

question:
Spot the error.

Hardly had the candidate entered the examination hall than (A) / the lights went off suddenly and (B) / the invigilators asked everyone to wait outside. (C)

options.text: Hardly had the candidate entered the examination hall than
the lights went off suddenly and
the invigilators asked everyone to wait outside.

explanation: 'Hardly/Scarcely' के साथ 'when' (या 'before') आता है, 'than' नहीं: 'Hardly had ... when the lights went off'।

question:
Spot the error.

Scarcely had the express train left the platform when (A) / the passengers started complaining about (B) / the shortage of drinking water in the coaches. (C)

options.text: Scarcely had the express train left the platform when
the shortage of drinking water in the coaches.

explanation: 'Scarcely had ... when' सही संयोजन है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Scarcely had the chief guest finished his speech [than] the audience began to leave the hall one by one.
explanation: 'Scarcely/Hardly' के बाद 'when' आता है, 'than' नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

The government has announced that the new agricultural policy (A) / not only will benefit the farmers in the remote villages but also the small traders (B) / who depend on the local markets for their livelihood. (C)

options.text: The government has announced that the new agricultural policy
not only will benefit the farmers in the remote villages but also the small traders
who depend on the local markets for their livelihood.

explanation: 'Not only ... but also' के बाद दोनों हिस्से एक जैसी संरचना में होने चाहिए: 'will benefit not only the farmers ... but also the small traders'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

[Not only he cheated in the examination] but also lied to the principal about it when he was questioned.

options.text: Not only did he cheat in the examination
Not only he had cheated in the examination
Not only cheated he in the examination

explanation: 'Not only' से वाक्य शुरू हो तो inversion आता है: 'Not only did he cheat ... but he also lied'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

[Not only did the minister inaugurate the bridge] but he also announced a special grant for the development of the village.

options.text: Not only the minister inaugurated the bridge
Not only had inaugurated the minister the bridge
Not only inaugurated the minister the bridge

explanation: 'Not only did + subject + V1 ... but ... also' सही संरचना है, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

The inquiry committee has recommended strict action (A) / against both the contractor who supplied the substandard material (B) / as well as the officials who approved the payment. (C)

options.text: The inquiry committee has recommended strict action
against both the contractor who supplied the substandard material
as well as the officials who approved the payment.

explanation: 'Both' के साथ 'and' आता है, 'as well as' नहीं: 'both the contractor ... and the officials'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

She is both a talented singer [or] a skilled dancer, and has performed on several national platforms.
explanation: 'Both' के साथ 'and' का जोड़ा आता है: 'both a talented singer and a skilled dancer'।

question:
Spot the error.

The new recruit has neither the required qualification (A) / nor the necessary experience, (B) / or any interest in learning the job. (C)

options.text: The new recruit has neither the required qualification
or any interest in learning the job.

explanation: 'Neither ... nor ... nor' की श्रृंखला में हर जगह 'nor' आता है: 'nor any interest' ('or' नहीं)।

question:
Spot the error.

The managing director did not attend the annual general meeting of the shareholders (A) / nor he sent any representative (B) / to apologise on his behalf. (C)

options.text: The managing director did not attend the annual general meeting of the shareholders

explanation: 'Nor' के बाद inversion (auxiliary + subject) आता है: 'nor did he send any representative'।

question:
Spot the error.

The agreement that was finally signed between (A) / the management of the company (B) / or the representatives of the labour union was welcomed by everyone. (C)

options.text: The agreement that was finally signed between
or the representatives of the labour union was welcomed by everyone.

explanation: 'Between' के साथ 'and' आता है, 'or' नहीं: 'between the management ... and the representatives'।

question:
Spot the error.

Neither the principal nor the teachers of the school (A) / were aware of the sudden decision taken (B) / by the board of trustees. (C)

options.text: Neither the principal nor the teachers of the school
were aware of the sudden decision taken

explanation: 'Neither ... nor' में verb nearest subject (teachers → plural) के अनुसार लगती है, इसलिए 'were' सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

The auditors could not ascertain (A) / whether the funds had been misused if (B) / the accounts had merely been maintained carelessly. (C)

options.text: whether the funds had been misused if
the accounts had merely been maintained carelessly.

explanation: 'Whether' के साथ विकल्प के लिए 'or' आता है, 'if' नहीं: 'whether the funds had been misused or the accounts had been maintained carelessly'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The question of [if the government will reduce] the fuel prices before the elections is being debated by economists across the country.
explanation: Preposition (of) के बाद 'if' नहीं आता, 'whether' आता है: 'the question of whether the government will reduce'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

There is no doubt [whether] the accused was present at the scene of the crime when the incident occurred.
explanation: 'No doubt' के बाद 'that' आता है (निश्चितता के लिए), 'whether' नहीं: 'no doubt that the accused was present'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Nobody can play the violin [like his father does], and that is why he is so popular among the music lovers.
explanation: Clause से पहले 'like' conjunction का काम नहीं करता, 'as' आता है: 'as his father does'।

question:
Spot the error.

The new manager is hardworking, sincere and has a lot of intelligence, (A) / and he commands respect among the junior employees (B) / because of his polite behaviour. (C)

options.text: The new manager is hardworking, sincere and has a lot of intelligence,
and he commands respect among the junior employees

explanation: Conjunction से जुड़े शब्द एक ही रूप में होने चाहिए (parallelism): 'hardworking, sincere and intelligent'।

question:
Spot the error.

The Chairman, who was deeply hurt by the baseless allegations, (A) / decided to resign from his post (B) / rather than he should accept the humiliating conditions. (C)

options.text: The Chairman, who was deeply hurt by the baseless allegations,
decided to resign from his post
rather than he should accept the humiliating conditions.

explanation: 'Rather than' के बाद भी parallel रूप आता है: 'decided to resign rather than accept the humiliating conditions'।

question:
Spot the error.

The manager must have left the office early this evening, (A) / for his car is not (B) / in the parking lot, and his cabin is locked. (C)

options.text: The manager must have left the office early this evening,
in the parking lot, and his cabin is locked.

explanation: 'For' (क्योंकि) कारण बताने वाला conjunction है और यहाँ बिल्कुल सही प्रयुक्त है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

She is not a lawyer but a chartered accountant (A) / who has been working in a multinational firm (B) / in Singapore for the last six years. (C)

options.text: She is not a lawyer but a chartered accountant
who has been working in a multinational firm
in Singapore for the last six years.

explanation: 'Not ... but' में दोनों parallel नाम हैं (a lawyer / a chartered accountant), इसलिए sentence सही है। कोई error नहीं।
